the places of hearing and the places of smelling, and those that look

The Illuminator said: Concerning this I say it to you, my
brothers, my beloveds, and my members: that with wisdom
and skill take charge over yourselves in the encompassing of the men of the bo-
dy — so that Sin which dwells in the body may not become strong
upon you, and take from your hand your light, and
scatter (you) forth from place to place, and spread (you) forth from
region to region, from fashion to fashion. May it not be! Therefore
let not this happen to you. But be men, watching,
ruling in your truth; be prepared from
the All to the All, so that your rest may co-
me to be with your end through this, while you watch unto the sign with
the hope.
